title: Axon Hub | Needle ESP, Auto Money Farm & Auto Gems
features:
Axon Hub for Needle Haystack brings together Auto Hay Farm, Auto Sell, Auto Gem Collection, Needle ESP, automated tools and upgrade management. Collect hay continuously, prioritize rainbow hay, manage your bag and automate the needle hand-in with customizable settings.
AUTO FARM & SELL
- Auto Collect Hay with adjustable search distance.
- Auto Sell when your bag reaches your selected fill level.
- Continuous collection and selling cycle.
- Automatically collect dropped hay.
- Prioritize Rainbow Hay while farming.
- Power Mode for faster collection timing.
- Automatic walking between farming targets.
- Sell your current bag with one click.
AUTOMATIC TOOLS
- Auto Vacuum with heat monitoring and automatic cooldown pauses.
- Auto Pitchfork for digging nearby hay.
- Auto Dynamite with adjustable throw timing and speed.
- Minimum hay-group setting for dynamite throws.
- Auto Drone deployment after each completed trip.
- Keep the selected collection tool equipped.
- Individual Power Mode settings for tool automation.
GEMS & NEEDLE OBJECTIVES
- Auto Collect nearby gems with adjustable reach.
- Automatically equip your needle before handing it in.
- Auto Walk to the Farmer once you own the needle.
- Auto Hand In the Needle to complete the objective.
- Auto Return to Lobby after the round finishes.
- Needle, Gem and Farmer markers.
- Objective notifications and collection tracking.
AUTO UPGRADES & SHOP
- Automatically purchase selected cash upgrades.
- Upgrade bag capacity, movement speed and collection stats.
- Automatic upgrades for owned tools.
- Choose upgrade priorities and maximum levels.
- Auto Buy selected missing tools.
- Auto Buy selected permanent gem upgrades.
- Set cash and gem reserves.
- Set spending limits for each run.
- Track your wallet, purchases and upgrade progress.
ESP & VISUALS
- Hay and Rainbow Hay ESP.
- Gem and Needle ESP.
- Farmer, Shop and Sell Point ESP.
- Player and Drone ESP.
- UFO, Key and Trapdoor markers when available.
- Names, distances and outlines.
- Adjustable marker distances and display limits.
EXTRA FEATURES
- Auto Skip Intro Cutscenes.
- Manual intro and outro skip controls.
- Disable camera shake.
- Mute game sounds.
- Hide information pop-ups.
- Anti-AFK.
- Adjustable FPS cap on supported executors.
- Live status HUD.
Tool automation uses tools you own, while automatic purchases follow your selected upgrades, available currency and spending limits.
